title: quercus faginea var. maroccana
intro: Quercus faginea var. maroccana, commonly known as Atlas White Oak, is a variety of oak tree native to the mountains of Morocco. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Quercus faginea var. maroccana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
